requirement: Describe CORIN/GASTO 1003 as a randomized, prospective, open-label Phase II trial comparing 12 months of adjuvant icotinib with observation after complete resection of stage IB EGFR-mutant non-small-cell lung cancer.

evidence.text: Protocol Version 1.1 title and synopsis define the design.
SAP Version 1.1 confirms the design.

requirement: Randomize eligible participants 1:1 to icotinib or observation through the GASTO central system, stratified by sex and ECOG performance status 0 versus 1.

evidence.text: The protocol defines allocation and stratification.
The SAP confirms central stratified randomization.

requirement: Define the primary endpoint as the proportion disease-free at three years after randomization, with disease-free survival events comprising documented recurrence or death from any cause.

evidence.text: The protocol identifies three-year DFS as primary.
The SAP defines the endpoint and event.

requirement: Analyze secondary endpoints of time-to-event DFS, central-nervous-system-related DFS, overall survival, treatment exposure and compliance, and safety, without replacing the primary three-year DFS proportion.

evidence.text: The protocol lists secondary outcomes.
The SAP operationalizes them.

requirement: Use the intent-to-treat set of all randomized participants, analyzed according to assigned group, for all DFS and overall-survival efficacy analyses.

evidence.text: The protocol specifies the efficacy population.
The SAP confirms ITT use.

requirement: Define the safety analysis set as participants receiving at least one dose of icotinib and having postdose safety data; summarize observation-arm safety separately without pretending exposure to study drug.

evidence.text: The SAP defines drug-exposed safety analysis.

requirement: Compare the treatment groups' three-year DFS proportions with the prespecified Z test and report the absolute difference with a two-sided confidence interval and p-value.

evidence.text: The SAP specifies the primary proportion comparison.

requirement: Estimate DFS, CNS-related DFS, and overall survival with Kaplan-Meier methods; compare groups with log-rank tests and estimate treatment hazard ratios with two-sided 95% confidence intervals from Cox proportional-hazards models.

evidence.text: The protocol identifies time-to-event analyses.
The SAP specifies KM, log-rank, and Cox methods.

requirement: Make no outcome imputations; censor participants without recurrence or death at the last adequate follow-up and define DFS and OS follow-up time from randomization with inclusive day counting.

evidence.text: The SAP gives censoring and time derivations.

requirement: Justify 128 randomized participants from assumed three-year DFS of 60% under observation and 80% under icotinib, 80% power, two-sided alpha 0.10, and allowance for loss to follow-up.

evidence.text: The protocol describes the Phase II sample-size target.
The SAP gives numeric assumptions.

requirement: Use the prespecified two-sided alpha 0.10 for the Phase II primary endpoint, report secondary endpoint p-values as exploratory, and conduct no interim efficacy analysis.

evidence.text: The SAP states alpha and no interim analysis.

requirement: Summarize adverse events at every visit using NCI-CTCAE Version 4.0, including incidence by event term, maximum grade, relationship, serious events, deaths, dose modification, and treatment discontinuation.

evidence.text: The protocol defines safety collection and grading.
The SAP defines safety summaries.

requirement: Prespecify whether stratified log-rank or Cox analyses adjusting for sex and ECOG performance status will supplement the unstratified analyses, and assess proportional-hazards assumptions before interpreting a single hazard ratio.

evidence.text: Randomization is stratified, but the concise analysis section does not fully resolve adjusted modeling.

requirement: Confirm the exact variance and confidence-interval method for the three-year DFS difference, handling of non-cancer deaths and incomplete disease assessments, and whether the Phase II alpha applies to any secondary claim.

evidence.text: The SAP provides a concise plan but leaves these operational details incomplete.
